entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Smt. Justice K. Sujana
 Criminal Petition No.3856 of 2024
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C.') by the petitioners, who are arrayed as accused Nos.3 and 4 in FIR, seeking to quash the proceedings against her in Crime No.105 of 2024 on the file of Police Station, Adilabad I town,
Adilabad, registered for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 468, 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 66 (Db) of Information Technology Amendment Act, 2008.

2. Heard Sri Kondadi Ajay Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri S. Ganesh, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor for respondent No.1 - State.
3.
As seen from the record, these petitioners are receivers of the amounts from accused No.1 and there is no direct transaction between the farmers.
Therefore, the ingredients of the offence under Section 409 of IPC are not attracted against the petitioners/accused Nos.3 and 4.

Therefore, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the petitioners to appear before the Investigating Officer on or before 26.04.2024 between 11:00 a.m. and 05:00 p.m. and in turn, the Investigating Officer is directed to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C. and also the guidelines formulated by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1 scrupulously.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar v. State of Bihar 1
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
However, the petitioners shall co-operate with the Investigating Officer as and when required by furnishing information and the petitioners shall produce all relevant documents/material required for the purpose of the investigation and the Investigating Officer shall consider the same before filing appropriate report before the learned Magistrate concerned.
4. Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is disposed of.
Miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall also stand closed.
_______________ K. SUJANA, J Date: 16.04.2024
